caption.ms: Aina simpan RM50 setiap bulan, bermula pada umur 19.
caption.en: Aina saves RM50 every month, starting at age 19.

caption.ms: Tanpa pulangan, simpanannya naik RM600 setahun. Selepas 10 tahun: RM6,000.
caption.en: With no returns, her savings rise by RM600 a year. After 10 years: RM6,000.

caption.ms: Pada kadar contoh 5% setahun, duitnya mula menjana pulangan (oren).
caption.en: At an example rate of 5% a year, her money starts to earn returns (orange).

caption.ms: Pulangan itu pula menjana pulangan. Selepas 10 tahun, RM6,000 jadi lebih kurang RM7,764.
caption.en: Those returns earn returns too. After 10 years, RM6,000 becomes about RM7,764.

caption.ms: Lagi lama dibiarkan, lagi laju ia membesar. Inilah kuasa kompaun.
caption.en: The longer it stays, the faster it grows. That is compound growth.

caption.ms: Mula umur 19: masuk RM21,600, jadi lebih kurang RM60,325 pada umur 55. Mula umur 29: masuk RM15,600, jadi lebih kurang RM31,913.
caption.en: Start at 19: put in RM21,600, worth about RM60,325 at 55. Start at 29: put in RM15,600, worth about RM31,913.

caption.ms: Kadar 5% ini contoh sahaja, bukan janji. Nilai pelaburan sebenar boleh naik dan turun; semak lesen dulu.
caption.en: The 5% rate is an example only, not a promise. Real investments go up and down; check the licence first.

caption.ms: Tawaran "bayar nanti": kadar rata contoh 18% setahun, bayar dalam 12 bulan.
caption.en: A "pay later" offer: an example flat rate of 18% a year, paid over 12 months.

caption.ms: Ansuran RM98.33 sebulan. Jumlah dibayar: RM1,180. RM180 itu kos hutang (merah).
caption.en: RM98.33 a month. Total paid: RM1,180. The RM180 is the cost of the debt (red).

caption.ms: Kadar rata dikira atas RM1,000 penuh setiap bulan, walaupun baki hutang makin kecil.
caption.en: A flat rate is charged on the full RM1,000 every month, even as the balance shrinks.

caption.ms: Sebab itu kadar sebenar setahun lebih kurang 31.7%, bukan 18%. Kos Sebenar dalam Kalkulator mengira ini.
caption.en: That is why the real yearly rate is about 31.7%, not 18%. Kos Sebenar in the Kalkulator works this out.

caption.ms: Pilih 24 bulan: ansuran turun ke RM56.67, tetapi jumlah naik ke RM1,360.
caption.en: Choose 24 months: the instalment drops to RM56.67, but the total rises to RM1,360.

caption.ms: Lewat bayar boleh menambah caj lagi. Baca semua caj sebelum setuju.
caption.en: Paying late can add more charges. Read every charge before you agree.

caption.ms: Atau simpan dulu: RM98.33 sebulan selama 11 bulan, kemudian beli tunai tanpa kos tambahan.
caption.en: Or save first: RM98.33 a month for 11 months, then pay cash with no extra cost.
